house.description: Sales and use tax exemption provided for construction materials used in a courthouse facility.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes

additions: (a) Materials and supplies used or consumed in and equipment incorporated into the construction, remodeling, expansion, or improvement of a county courthouse facility are exempt.
(b) The tax must be imposed and collected as if the rate under section 297A.62, subdivision 1, applied and then refunded in the manner provided in section 297A.75.
This section is effective for sales and purchases made after June 30, 2026.
